name: Detroit Edible | 200mg Treats | Bee Sting Honey
description: Detroit Edibles took honey and infused it with cannabis to create one of the most unique and versatile edibles on the market. Bee Sting Honey is perfect for grilling some honey-glazed salmon, spreading on a piece of toast or adding to your cup of tea. Contains 200mg THC and fully activates in 1-2 hours.
